sentences.en: As we make our way through life,
sentences.zh: 在我们漫步人生的旅途中，

sentences.en: all of us have access to a rich repository of wisdom.
sentences.zh: 我们每个人都拥有一个丰富的智慧宝库。

sentences.en: This storehouse of knowledge can help us make better decisions,
sentences.zh: 这座知识的仓库能帮助我们做出更好的决策，

sentences.en: cultivate closer relationships, and enhance the quality of our work.
sentences.zh: 培养更亲密的关系，并提升我们工作质量。

sentences.en: It can help us be better partners and parents,
sentences.zh: 它能帮助我们成为更好的伴侣和父母，

sentences.en: better artists and writers, better entrepreneurs and leaders.
sentences.zh: 更好的艺术家和作家，更好的企业家和领袖。

sentences.en: How do we tap into this deep well of insight?
sentences.zh: 我们该如何汲取这深邃的洞察之泉呢？

sentences.en: We need to listen to others who know more than us
sentences.zh: 我们需要倾听那些比我们懂得更多的人，

sentences.en: and to learn from those who see more clearly than we do.
sentences.zh: 并向那些看得比我们更透彻的人学习。

sentences.en: Whether it's a veteran member of our profession,
sentences.zh: 无论是我们行业中的资深前辈，
经验丰富的父母或祖父母，

sentences.en: or a couple with decades of marriage behind them,

sentences.en: other people can provide us with tools, expertise, and insight,
sentences.zh: 其他人都能为我们提供工具、专业知识和见解，

sentences.en: incalculably valuable assets in any life.
sentences.zh: 在任何人生阶段，这些都是价值无可估量的财富。

sentences.en: So why is it, given all the wisdom we have within easy reach,
sentences.zh: 那么为什么，既然我们触手可及拥有这么多智慧，

sentences.en: we so often resist or reject what other people have to tell us?
sentences.zh: 我们却常常抗拒或拒绝听取别人的意见呢？
